entries.summary: 1353, die 24 aprilis, Ecclesiae herbipolensis capitulum sex canonicos arbitratores quorundam jurium suorum conservandorum eligit
entries.latin:
Jn nomine domini amen.
Nos Heinricus de Reinstein decanus, totumque .. capitulum
ecclesie herbipolensis ad vniuersorum presencium et futurorum
noticiam deducimus per presentes, quod nos anno domini millesimo
CCC° Lmo tercio, die vicesimaquarta mensis aprilis, in loco nostro
capitulari ob hoc specialiter et capitulariter congregati, pluribus
tractatibus et maturis deliberacionibus sepius prehabitis pro refor-
macione status jurium libertatum priuilegiorum et consuetudinum
ecclesie nostre herbipolensis in capite et in membris ac per-
sonis ipsius presentibus et futuris, elegimus et deputauimus concor-
diter vnanimiter, nemine discenciente discrepante uel contradicente,
ac eciam eligimus et presentibus deputamus arbitratores conmissarios
ordinatores conpromissarios dispositores et diffinitores honorabiles
dominos Heinricum decanum predictum, Johannem Pincernam
de Erpach archidiaconum, Johannem de Rosenberg, Engel-
hardum de Bebenburg, Ernestum de Ristenhusen, et
Fridericum de Kastil, nostros concanonicos ecclesie herbipo-
lensis, super prescriptis et infrascriptis articulis et eciam modo
prescripto, videlicet super translacione judiciorum ipsius ecclesie
herbipolensis ad alium seu alia loca episcopatus herbipo-
lensis, ac eciam de recessu a ciuitate herbipolensi et reditu
ad eandem, et super ordinandis certis peremptorijs capitulis et alijs
ad certa loca episcopatus predicti, et super amministracione et per-
cepcione fructuum beneficiorum nostrorum tempore absencie, ac
canonum seu pensionum oblagiorum nostrorum solucione, ac eciam
super amicabili conposicione inienda attemptanda et facienda super
parrochiali ecclesia jn Kitzingen dyocesis herbipolensis,
ex qua jus capituli nostri in eadem finaliter et totaliter non ledatur,
ac eciam super residencia concanonicorum nostrorum ad presens
uel inposterum iuxta consuetudinem ecclesie nostre absencium in
loco uel locis dicti episcopatus eis deputando uel deputandis debite
facienda, dantes ipsis omnimodam plenam generalem et liberam ca-
pitularem potestatem super premissis et eorum quolibet ac alijs ex
eis emergentibus contingentibus dependentibus et connexis arbitrandi
ordinandi disponendi diffiniendi et faciendi prout ipsis secundum
deum et eorum conscienciam melius videbitur expedire, promittentes-
que pro nobis et successoribus nostris quicquid per ipsos in pre-
missis uel circa ea arbitratum ordinatum dispositum diffinitum uel
factum fuerit tenere inuiolabiliter et obseruare.
Licitum eciam est cuilibet dictorum sex conpromissariorum
nostrorum, quociens aliquem ab esse contigerit, interim alium capitu-
larem et vocem habentem de choro suo subrogare.
Si autem aliquis ipsorum cesserit uel decesserit, subperstites
alium ut prefertur de choro ipsius cedentis uel decedentis infra
quindenam postquam hoc sciuerint subrogare vtique teneantur.
Actum et datum anno die et loco supradictis.
Jn quorum omnium testimonium et roboris firmitatem maius
sigillum capituli nostri ex certa cuiuslibet nostrum sciencia pre-
sentibus est appensum.
entries.english:
In the name of the Lord, amen. We, Heinrich von Reinstein, dean, and the whole chapter of the church of Würzburg make known by these presents to the knowledge of all present and future that in the year of the Lord 1353, on the twenty-fourth day of April, specially and capitularly assembled for this in our chapter place, after many discussions and mature deliberations often held, for the reform of the state of the rights, liberties, privileges and customs of our church of Würzburg in head and members and its present and future persons, we have elected and deputed concordantly and unanimously, none dissenting, differing or objecting, and do now elect and by these presents depute as arbitrators, commissaries, regulators, compromissaries, dispositors and definers the honourable lords Heinrich, the dean aforesaid, Johann Schenk von Erbach, archdeacon, Hans von Rosenberg, Engelhard von Bebenburg, Ernst von Ristenhusen and Friedrich von Kastil, our fellow canons of the church of Würzburg, on the articles written above and below and also in the manner prescribed, namely: on the transfer of the courts of the church of Würzburg to another place or places of the diocese of Würzburg, and also on withdrawal from the city of Würzburg and return to it; and on arranging certain peremptory chapters and others at certain places of the aforesaid diocese; and on the administration and receipt of the fruits of our benefices in the time of absence, and the payment of the dues or pensions of our offerings; and also on attempting and making an amicable settlement concerning the parish church in Kitzingen in the diocese of Würzburg, by which the right of our chapter in it shall not finally and totally be harmed; and also on the residence of our fellow canons, present or future, who are absent according to the custom of our church, to be duly performed in the place or places of the said diocese assigned or to be assigned to them; giving them all manner of full, general and free capitular power to arbitrate, ordain, dispose, define and do on the foregoing and on each of them and on others arising, occurring, depending and connected with them, as it shall seem to them best according to God and their conscience; and promising for ourselves and our successors to hold and observe inviolably whatever is arbitrated, ordained, disposed, defined or done by them in the foregoing or concerning it.
It is also lawful for each of our said six compromissaries, whenever one happens to be absent, to substitute meanwhile another capitular having a voice from his own choir.
But if one of them resigns or dies, the survivors shall be bound to substitute another, as stated, from the choir of the one resigning or dying within a fortnight after they know of it.
Done and given in the year, day and place aforesaid.
In testimony of all which and for firmness of strength, our chapter's greater seal has been appended to these presents with the certain knowledge of each of us.

facts.content: issued the chapter's election of six canons as arbitrators of its rights, and was himself one of them.

was elected by the Würzburg cathedral chapter as one of six arbitrators on the rights, liberties and customs of the church, the removal of its courts, absence and residence of canons and the parish church of Kitzingen.
